extracted.intended_audience: Colorado State University faculty, graduate students, and researchers seeking internal or external research funding
extracted.subtask_description: A university office landing page listing internal and external funding programs, and support resources for proposal development, aimed at CSU faculty, staff, and students seeking research or creative-activity funding. The page groups opportunities (internal/external) and directs users to institutional support offices and tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of the Vice President for Research mission
rubrics_metrics.description: A fundamental goal of the Office of the Vice President for Research is to enhance the research climate at Colorado State University.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The office helps students and faculty in all disciplines by generating internal and external funding for scholarly and creative activities, and provides grant writing resources, proposal development services, and technical assistance.
